title: Length Discounts and Handover Charges on the Keyturn Trip Booking Rate Plans
content:
Two length discounts and two handover charges are carried as plan figures on a Keyturn Trip Booking: the discount taken off the base rate on reservations of a week or more, the discount taken on reservations of a month or more, the fee for delivering the vehicle to the guest, and the surcharge added when the handover happens at an airport.

| Figure | Hourly | Daily | Weekend | Weekly | Monthly | Extended Stay |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Weekly discount (per cent of base rate) | 0 | 0 | 0 | 12 | 12 | 12 |
| Monthly discount (per cent of base rate) | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 22 | 28 |
| Delivery fee (USD) | 29.00 | 39.00 | 45.00 | 55.00 | 65.00 | 75.00 |
| Airport surcharge (USD) | 24.00 | 32.00 | 36.00 | 42.00 | 48.00 | 55.00 |

### How the four figures sit on the ladder

The weekly discount is carried at 0 per cent on the Keyturn Hourly, Daily and Weekend Rate Plans, which is to say those three plans publish no weekly discount, and at 12 per cent on the Keyturn Weekly, Monthly and Extended Stay Rate Plans. The monthly discount is carried at 0 per cent on the first four plans and appears only at the top of the ladder, at 22 per cent on the Keyturn Monthly Rate Plan and 28 per cent on the Keyturn Extended Stay Rate Plan.

Both handover charges rise monotonically with the plan. The delivery fee runs from 29.00 to 75.00 USD, and the airport surcharge from 24.00 to 55.00 USD.
